author: CMS-HGCAL
body: #### PR description: This PR introduces a SOA-based CondFormat and a ESProducer of aging conditions for the SIM-DIGI step of HGCAL. For the moment the producer re-casts the algorithm-based classes that were already present in SimCalorimetery/HGCalSimAlgos. The algorithm-based classes have been slightly re-worked in order to address [issue 52113](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52113) and accommodate for the new HD200 wafer case. We also remove old txt files which were forcing the SiPM size - an information which now is provided by the DetId itself. #### PR validation: So far the output of these CondFormats have only be compared at DQM level at the level of the commissioning with cassette data in P5 see picture below and [these slides](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1739500/contributions/7313410/attachments/3360397/6027924/ElecSimulation_CondFormats_2026Oct12.pdf) Locally I also run successfully 38434.103 #### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for: Phase 2 - no back port
title: HGCAL : CondFormats for aging
